data.name: Miami Beach Ultimate City Bike Tour
data.headline: Starting at $49.99 | 3 Hours | Experience the Best of Miami Beach!
data.description: Discover the best of Miami Beach on a fun and relaxing bike tour, perfect for all fitness levels! Pedal through the iconic Art Deco district, soak in the sun along Ocean Drive, visit the amazing homes of Star Island, and explore the unique culture and top attractions of this tropical paradise. This is the ultimate way to experience Miami Beach!

meeting_point.address: Caffe Umbria, 959 West Ave Suite 1, Miami Beach, FL 33139

data.what_to_bring:
Bring a refillable water bottle
Wear loose, comfortable clothing
data.cancellation_notes:
Reservation is fully refundable (minus a 10% processing fee on credit card purchases) if reservation is canceled at least three days (72 hours) prior to scheduled tour. No cancels within 72 hours. $10/person service fee for any weekend reservation changes made within 72 hours. If severe weather forces us to cancel our tour, we will be happy to reschedule your tour, offer a gift card, or offer a full refund.

Any changes/cancellations must be in writing by emailing miamireservations@bobbysbikehike.com.  

While you may register as a solo rider on our tours, there is a 2-person minimum for this particular tour to go out.  If we do not hit this threshold 2 hours before tour time we may contact you to reschedule or possibly cancel the tour with full refund.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for choosing Bobby's Bike Hike - Miami. We look forward to having you as our guest!

**FILL OUT PRE-ARRIVAL WAIVER:**
Be on the lookout for a pre-arrival waiver we're sending you, via email, from no-reply@wherewolf.co.nz. Please fill out this form before you arrive to save some time and maximize fun!

**NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS:**
No refunds or rescheduling of your tour within 72 hours prior to the tour (24 hrs if you pre-purchased non-refundable Breathe Easy Trip Insurance). No exceptions: Not if your flight was late, if there was traffic, if you booked the wrong date, if you booked the wrong number of people, if you got ill, if you had an emergency or for any other reason, please contact your travel or CC insurance policy.  Any changes/cancellations outside of 72 hrs (or 24 hrs if Breathe Easy trip ins) must be in writing by emailing reservations@bobbysbikehike.com.  Any tour changes are subject to a rescheduling fee. Late arrivals are subject to be rebooked, in order to preserve experience and timeline of tour (not eligible for refunds; rescheduling fees will apply).

**PLEASE ARRIVE 15 MINUTES EARLY:**
Please make every effort not to be late so that other guests don't have to wait - and make sure to arrive 15 minutes prior to check in.  Please use the Restroom before your arrival (no restrooms on site). Please stay with the bike tour the entire time. If guests leave the bike tour early and leave the bikes behind, we have to charge a $29.99 per bike fee to retrieve.

**GRATUITY:**
In the tour industry, it is customary to tip the tour guide. Therefore, if you enjoyed your tour, please make sure to take care of your guide. $10 per person is a standard gratuity for this particular tour. All guides accept Venmo or cash. No ATM on site.

**MEETING POINT:**
Caffe Umbria
959 West Ave Suite 1, Miami Beach, FL 33139
[Click here](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RqUg6PUkLZWSBpTA9) to view our Meeting Location 

**PARKING:**
1224 10th Street, Miami Beach, FL 33139 (next to Caffe Umbria (the meeting location)
All parking arrangements are made directly with Parking Garage. Please allow extra time to park so you can arrive 15 minutes early for tour check-in. 

**WEATHER and CLOTHES:**
We tour rain or shine.  We do provide ponchos if it is announced to rain. But dress for current weather conditions, Miami can get hot with unexpected pop-up showers, so be prepared. Wear comfortable clothing/shoes (Closed-toed shoes preferred)

**GET SOCIAL:**
[Follow us on Instagram to get ready for your Miami Adventure and see photos/videos](https://www.instagram.com/bobbysbikehike/)

[Follow us on Facebook to get ready for your Miami Adventure and see photos/videos](https://www.facebook.com/bobbysbikehiketours)

[Follow us on YouTube to get a behind the scenes look into our company](https://www.youtube.com/user/BobbysBikeHike)

**TOUR DETAILS**
- Tour price includes bike and helmet
- Must be able to ride a bike and keep up with group pace
- Ages 10 and older please. We do not have child equipment or bikes available for under 10.
- Tours may run up to 15-20 minutes over or under the scheduled end time due to a variety of factors
- We ask that you stay with your guide during the duration of the tour
- Bring a camera, plenty of views and picture opportunities

We look forward to seeing you soon,

**Bobby's Bike Hike - Miami**
miamireservations@bobbysbikehike.com
